source.en: a person, place, or thing that provides something, such as information

rival.en: a person or thing competing with another for the same goal

condition.en: the state that something is in; a requirement

waste.en: something used carelessly or thrown away because it is no longer wanted

repository.en: a place where things, especially information or knowledge, are stored

resource.en: something useful that people can draw on for help or information

conduit.en: a channel through which something, such as news or water, passes

record.en: a written or stored account of facts or events

skeptical.en: doubting that something is true or useful

observant.zh: 善於觀察的；觀察入微的

confident.en: feeling sure about yourself or your abilities

perceptive.en: quick to notice and understand things

watchful.en: carefully watching and noticing what happens

discerning.en: able to notice fine differences and judge well
discerning.zh: 有洞察力的；眼光敏銳的

demands.en: asks for something firmly, as if it is owed

speculates.en: forms an opinion or guess without having firm evidence

doubts.en: feels unsure whether something is true

establishes.en: proves or shows something to be true; sets something up

hypothesizes.en: proposes an explanation that can be tested

theorizes.en: forms a theory or idea about why something happens

surmises.en: supposes something is true without strong evidence

conjectures.en: forms an opinion based on incomplete information

synchronization.en: the act of making things happen at the same time

hibernation.en: the state of an animal spending the winter in a deep sleep

prediction.en: a statement about what will happen in the future

coordination.en: the organization of different parts so they work together smoothly

alignment.en: an arrangement in which things match up or agree

simultaneity.en: the fact of happening at the same time

a superficial.en: concerned only with obvious or surface details; not deep

an exhaustive.zh: 詳盡無遺的；全面徹底的

a questionable.en: possibly not true or reliable; open to doubt

superficial.en: concerned only with obvious or surface details; not deep

exhaustive.zh: 詳盡無遺的；全面徹底的

questionable.en: possibly not true or reliable; open to doubt

comprehensive.en: including all or nearly all parts or aspects

thorough.en: done completely and carefully, with attention to every detail

complete.en: having all the necessary parts; whole

all-inclusive.zh: 無所不包的；包羅萬象的
